spec.baseline: Previously archived matched-year old DE30 H1, D1, equal-risk and source-risk; no-trade cash.

costs.assumptions: Native price-unit proxies 1x / 1.5x / 2x per-side fee ladder; missing true broker spread, CFD overnight financing, multi-CCY FX conversion, contract tick/lot multiplier.

evaluation.holdout_policy: Years 2013-2026 YTD were previously observed via DE30 candidate. This is exploratory, not virgin validation. Do not read 2026-10-12 onward.
evaluation.periods: Independent Jan-Dec 2013-2025 year-reset comparisons, 2026 Jan1-Oct11 YTD, preceding July1 warmup. No continuous carry/FX conversion; source model unchanged.

spec.falsifier: REJECT if JP225 replacement does not improve paired-year Sharpe and risk/drawdown across 2013-2026 and withstand predeclared cost stress. INCONCLUSIVE for broker economics while JPY/EUR FX accounting, stop/fill parity, bid ask and CFD terms are unresolved.
spec.mechanism: Market-specific breakout behavior and mean reversion differ between European and Japanese indices.
spec.thesis: Replace DE30 with JP225 in H1/D1 index source sleeves and test whether the same frozen rules and risk budgets improve price-proxy risk-adjusted performance versus prior DE30 baseline.
